Today's Easy Decluttering Project

DAY TWO of looking at this series and simplifying it! :)

”What I know for sure is that when you declutter whether it's in your home, your head, or your heart it is astounding what will flow into that space that will enrich you, your life, and your family.”

Peter Walsh

  • Gather all your toiletries in one place (this includes those from all bathtubs/showers as well as any cupboards, drawers, and closets they may be in throughout your house)

  • Throw away any products that are expired or old and re-package any items that are leaking

  • Relocate everything that doesn't belong with your toiletries and combine partially used bottles of products that you want to keep using

  • Give away items that you have not used in over 6 months (or whatever time period is reasonable to you) By the way, shelters are great places to donate toiletries!

Additional thoughts

  • Check your bug out bag and camping supplies if products have expired or need replacing.

  • Everything has a cost associated with it, even free samples are taking up space and unnecessary if you are NOT using it.

LASTLY: Let’s be honest with ourselves here.

If you think you still want to keep something but you know you haven't used it in quite awhile, ask yourself;

Why haven't I used this?

Do I like the scent/texture/results/ingredients?

Is this product inferior to another I am already using?

Let these questions guide your decision to keep it or give it away.

All the best Ladies on this journey to lighten the load and make room for better more functional products that we actually use and love.

Happy decluttering and happy Friday!
